rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone acts openly rather than secretly.

example.english: They publicly admitted they were wrong.
example.traditional: 佢公開咁承認自己錯咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gung1 hoi1 gam2 sing4 jing6 zi6 gei2 co3 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something happens in front of other people or an audience.

example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 dong1 zung3 naau6 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for something made available, provided, or announced to people outside an organisation or group.

example.english: The company publicly announced the new arrangements.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 deoi3 ngoi6 gung1 bou3 san1 on1 paai4
